description: The Gateway Island Trail is a 4.3km sealed loop along the Murray River and Wodonga Creek, with the trailhead behind The Lincoln at 64 Lincoln Causeway on Gateway Island. name: High Country Rail Trail
description: The High Country Rail Trail runs 81km from Wodonga to Shelley along a former railway line, surfaced in fine gravel and sealed sections. The Wodonga end starts at 2 Mill St, with a central access point in Reid St near the bowling club, and the first 5km to the Kiewa Valley Hwy is hot-mix asphalt suited to a wide range of users.
